title: finding(plugin-dashboard): `DashboardGridLayout` composes NO chart series label, so its legend renders the raw field key while the sibling relay renders the humanized one
body:
`DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout` are the two relays that compose a chart node for the same dashboard widget. objectui#8266 already treated them as twins for the series **dataKey** and fixed both. They are NOT twins for the series **label**: only `DashboardRenderer` composes one at all.

## Measured

Both relays, both branches, one probe run on `origin/main` plus the objectui#9055 fix (branch `claude/issue-9055-field-key-spelling-outside-table`). The probe registers a recorder for `object-chart` / `chart` and reads `series[0]` off the node each relay composed — the same harness `DashboardChart.countSeriesKey-8266.test.tsx` uses:

```
renderer  object-bound  dataKey="close_date"  label="Close Date"
renderer  static-data   dataKey="unit_price"  label="Unit Price"
grid      object-bound  dataKey="close_date"  label=undefined
grid      static-data   dataKey="unit_price"  label=undefined
```

`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardGridLayout.tsx` composes `series: [{ dataKey: effectiveYField }]` on the object-bound branch and `series: [{ dataKey: yField }]` on the static branch — no `label` key on either.

## Why an absent label is a rendered raw key, not a no-op

`ChartRenderer` (`packages/plugin-charts/src/ChartRenderer.tsx`) builds the chart config with `newConfig[s.dataKey] = { label: s.label || s.dataKey, ... }`. With no `label`, the legend and tooltip text IS the raw field key. So a grid-laid-out dashboard legends a measure `close_date` where the same widget on the other relay legends it `Close Date`.

## Why this is filed rather than folded into objectui#9055

objectui#9055 names two producers, both inside `DashboardRenderer` / `RecordDetailDrawer`, and its dispatch ruled the diff must not widen. This is a different file and a different mechanism: the fix there was "the fallback handed to `fieldLabel` was the raw key"; here there is no label expression at all, so a repair ADDS a label to a surface that has never had one. That is a behaviour change on an unnamed surface, and it needs its own pins for a second relay.

⚠️ Note the direction of the debt: before objectui#9055 the two relays AGREED (both legended the raw key). Its fix moves one of them, so this card is the other half of that family, not a pre-existing divergence someone can keep deferring.

## What a fix has to decide

Whether `DashboardGridLayout` grows its own `resolveSeriesLabel`, or the callback moves somewhere both relays read. objectui#9055's fix deliberately did NOT lift the helper — `humanizeFieldKey` stays in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/utils.ts` and both relays are in that same package, so sharing costs no new dependency edge. The synthetic-key arm (a count aggregation resolving an i18n aggregate name) must survive whichever route is taken; it is pinned as a live control in `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/fieldKeySpellingOutsideTable-9055.test.tsx`.

## Dedup

Repo-scoped REST list of all open issues, all five pages, PRs filtered out (441 issues), matched locally. Positive control: the term `resolveSeriesLabel` returned objectui#9055, so the empty results are readings rather than a silent zero. Scans run: `DashboardGridLayout` (2 hits, objectui#8820 auto-refresh timers and objectui#7353 `dataProvider` declaration — neither this), `series label` (2 hits, objectui#9150 is plugin-report's chart title), `legend` (5 hits, objectui#7696 is an i18n option-label coverage gap and objectui#4044 is `chartConfig` key liveness — both already excluded by objectui#9055's own dedup).
